scope.summary: Sprint 6 operator APIs, read models, audit persistence, Excel export, web frontend, migration integration, and focused tests.
artifactsReviewed: Android regression and APK permission evidence
scope.runtimeStatus: Backend, PostgreSQL, frontend, Android build, and API 35 instrumentation passed; Docker unavailable.
scope.validationMode: Manual source review plus automated unit, integration, migration, browser, build, and Android checks.
scope.context: Standard single-pass security review. Delegated worker capacity was unavailable after preflight, so the coordinator completed the documented fallback review.
limitations: No dependency or container vulnerability scanner was available.
Docker runtime was not installed, so the image was not built.

threatModel.summary: An unauthenticated network client or malicious receipt content may try to read operator data, cross device boundaries, exhaust bounded operations, inject active workbook or browser content, or erase/forge audit evidence.
trustBoundaries: untrusted receipt and OCR text to UI and Excel
attackerCapabilities: send unauthenticated or malformed HTTP requests
control receipt text rendered or exported
securityObjectives: no browser persistence of bearer tokens
assumptions: TLS and reverse-proxy security are deployment responsibilities
administrators are trusted to view all enrolled devices
